culprit_citations.quoted_text: Total Investments, at fair value (amortized cost of $2,963,987 and $2,883,469, respectively) | 2,943,879 | 2,882,954

rationale: Class 3 anchor triangulation disproves the apparent 51.7% coverage loss. The filing reports current total investments at fair value of $2,943.879 million, while the extracted holdings total is $2,943.767 million, a difference of only $0.112 million (about 0.004%). Therefore an output count of 342 cannot represent omission of roughly half the investment value. The source count of 708 is not a comparable position-count anchor; it is consistent with duplicated or fact-level cardinality (for example, multiple monetary facts per investment). E07 is a false alarm caused by a bad source-count anchor, not a holdings data error.
